upgrade.name: v0.14.4
upgrade.summary: v0.14.4 is the next Starknet upgrade. Mainnet activation is pending governance approval. A full node must be Pathfinder 0.24.0 or Juno 0.16.6. The announcement names those versions.
upgrade.order_summary: An operator runs Pathfinder or Juno. No separate consensus client is part of this upgrade.
upgrade.warning: Testnet is September 15, 2026. That date is not a mainnet deadline. Mainnet is listed as October 5, 2026, pending governance approval. That is not an activation time. A newer Pathfinder or Juno release is not the announced requirement. SNIP-36 prover operators are not this check.
